svg.text: Agents argue, code computes. Numbers come from deterministic tools, never from model text.

g.text: FastAPI + Server-Sent Events + Single-Page UI (no build step)
Courtroom timeline UI: Rider (left) · Driver (right) · Judge (center) · evidence chips · live streaming
Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles, vanilla JS, no build step — works at 1280 px and on a phone.

svg.text: Every arrow is a typed message on the case's event log (DISPUTE_FILED, EVIDENCE, CLAIM, REBUTTAL, RISK_SIGNAL, PRECEDENT, RULING, ESCALATION, HUMAN_OVERRIDE).
The Guard rejects agent output that cites unknown IDs or states a number not in the evidence pack; the agent retries once, then escalates to a human.
RideCourt · Tencent Cloud AI CAN DO IT Hackathon Singapore 2026 (Ryde) · Apache-2.0
